method: Paired and pooled T.TEST/TTEST controls (types 1 and 2), plus shared argument validation. Each expression was independently evaluated and entered through formula2, with matching numeric-text/error probes and checked stored formulas. Temporary ranges were cleared and COUNTA verified zero. The wider source captures retain Welch (type 3) and variance/covariance diagnostics for separate unresolved algorithm investigations; those are not claimed as passing controls here.
